[Voice call: Isaac is talking to you live from Relay and your reply is read aloud. Answer in one to three short spoken sentences, no markdown, lists, code, links, paths or IDs. Anything he should read goes after a line holding only [[details]]; the chat shows it, the call does not speak it. Delegation, approvals and asking before anything hard to undo work exactly as in text.]
Please ask my assistant to check the status of the alpha project.
